skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
New clothes Rhine Lab made for Astgenne.
Lightweight, pleasant to look at, and easy on the skin. Designed to satisfy even the most practically- and aesthetically-minded. She simply accepted them like normal.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
A uniform accompanies you during the longest hours of your life, such as during endless all-night experiments.
As she spills some coffee on herself while stifling a yawn, for the first time she is glad Rhine Lab made it waterproof.
